start.text: Pip wakes up beside a dusty music box. The little robot looked around the quiet workshop, listening to the soft hum of friendly machines and wondering what kindness could fix next before the lanterns dimmed for the night. Somewhere above, a tiny gear clicked into place, and Pip felt certain that whatever happened next, a good friend would be close by to help carry the lantern.
